Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Interface LmClient

All Known Implementing Classes:
HttpLmClient, MockLmClient
public interface LmClient
Pluggable language-model client contract for the TA recruitment system.

LmClient is the central abstraction of the LM integration layer. Callers (servlets and com.bupt.ta.service.ai services) build a LmRequest, invoke generate(LmRequest) or stream(LmRequest, LmStreamListener), and consume a vendor-neutral LmResponse. Implementations must not expose provider-specific JSON or HTTP details to callers.

Concrete implementations are selected by LmClientFactory from LmConfig:

  • MockLmClient — offline, deterministic responses for demos and tests
  • HttpLmClient — HTTPS JSON calls to OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions APIs

  • Method Details

    • generate

      LmResponse generate(LmRequest request) throws LmException
      Sends a completion request and returns the full model output in one response.
      Parameters:
      request - unified prompt/messages, sampling parameters, and optional feature name; must not be null
      Returns:
      a normalised LmResponse with assistant text, provider id, model name, success flag, and optional raw payload or error message
      Throws:
      LmException - if configuration is invalid, the HTTP transport fails, or request/response parsing fails (HttpLmClient only)

    • stream

      default void stream(LmRequest request, LmStreamListener listener) throws LmException
      Streams completion text incrementally to the supplied listener.

      Default implementation delegates to generate(LmRequest) and emits fixed-size chunks (48 characters) via LmStreamListener.onDelta(String). HTTP providers such as HttpLmClient should override this method to use real Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming.

      Parameters:
      request - the same LmRequest shape as generate(LmRequest)
      listener - callbacks for partial text, completion, and errors; must not be null
      Throws:
      LmException - if the underlying generate(LmRequest) call throws, or if streaming setup or I/O fails in overriding implementations
